Prednisolone Prednisolone

ATC S01BA04 · Substance ID prednisolone

Easily confused with：Prednisone（Prednisone predniSONE） FDA recommends tall-man lettering for this pair; check the ingredient, not the name. All pairs
The same ingredient can carry completely different brand names in different countries, and the same name can point to a different ingredient. Listed by country — not interchangeable.
